text: 证监会官网信息显示，9月11日，华夏、招商、鹏华、华安等基金公司上报了中证新能源金属50ETF，这也是全市场首批中证新能源金属50ETF。上述产品跟踪的中证新能源金属50指数，主要反映锂、钴、镍、稀土等新能源金属主题上市公司证券的整体表现。
text_en: Information on the CSRC website shows that on September 11, fund companies including ChinaAMC, China Merchants, Penghua, and Hua An submitted filings for the CSI New Energy Metals 50 ETF, which is also the first batch of CSI New Energy Metals 50 ETFs in the entire market. The CSI New Energy Metals 50 Index tracked by the above products mainly reflects the overall performance of securities of listed companies in the new energy metals theme, such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earths.
